properties.areaDesc: Gore and Elk Mountains/Central Mountain Valleys
properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 4 at 10:14AM MST until November 5 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected above 10000 feet. Total snow accumulations
between 4 and 8 inches with locally higher amounts possible.

* WHERE...Gore and Elk Mountains/Central Mountain Valleys.

* WHEN...From 2 PM this afternoon to 5 AM MST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult. The hazardous conditions
will impact the Wednesday evening commute. Roads, and especially
bridges and overpasses, will likely become slick and hazardous.
properties.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. The latest road conditions
for the state you are calling from can be obtained by calling 5 1 1.

NWSheadline: WINTER WEATHER ADVISORY REMAINS IN EFFECT FROM 2 PM THIS AFTERNOON TO 5 AM MST THURSDAY ABOVE 10000 FEET

properties.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 4 at 9:48AM MST until November 5 at 5:00AM MST by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations between 4 and 9
inches. Locally higher amounts up to 11 inches will be possible.

* WHERE...Eastern Sawatch Mountains Above 11000 Feet, Pikes Peak
Above 11000 Feet, Western Chaffee County Between 9000 and 11000
Feet, Western Mosquito Range/East Chaffee County Above 9000 Feet,
and Western Mosquito Range/East Lake County Above 11000 Feet.

* WHEN...From 2 PM this afternoon to 5 AM MST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be very difficult to impossible. The
hazardous conditions will impact the Wednesday evening commute.
properties.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. The latest road conditions
for the state you are calling from can be obtained by calling 5 1 1.
